Brand Intro:

At RA EGYPTIAN, we have worked closely with Egyptologists to uncover the secrets of ancient Egyptian skincare ingredients. By integrating these age-old practices with modern formulations, we have crafted a luxurious skincare line that delivers undeniable results. Our products enhance radiance, smoothness, and reduce the signs of aging - our reviews speak for themselves.

Our Products:

Our product line is a 5-product complete skincare system featuring a range of meticulously crafted hero products, which include rare and highly effective ingredients like desert date oil and East African shea nilotica. We have two cleansers, two moisturizers and a lip balm that customers stalk us for. Our formulas are designed to transform your skin, and they do.

Truly Unique Skincare:

RA EGYPTIAN is a completely unique skincare experience and unlike anything else on the market. We’re distinguished by our use of rare and potent ingredients, meticulously researched and inspired by ancient Egyptian skincare practices. Our collaboration with Egyptologists has enabled us to recreate these time-honored rituals, ensuring our products offer unparalleled hydration and rejuvenation. The result is a skincare experience that not only enhances beauty but also provide visible and undeniable results.

Payment Terms:

Join the RA EGYPTIAN Affiliate Program and earn a 15% commission on every sale generated through your unique affiliate link. Payments are processed on a monthly basis, ensuring you receive timely and consistent earnings for your promotional efforts.

Other Information:

We provide our affiliates with comprehensive marketing materials, including high-quality images, banners, and detailed product descriptions to effectively promote our brand. We can also create custom assets if needed. Our products sell incredibly well, and we want to get them to a wider audience. Join us today and be part of our mission to bring luxurious, effective skincare solutions to a wider market.

If you have any further questions or need more details, feel free to reach out to us at info@ra-egyptian.com.
